qualification.details: Associate Engineer Gr.I - Inspection Mechanical/ Metallurgical: BE/ B. Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Mechanical/ Metallurgical Engineering. Experience: 2 years of relevant post qualification experience in inspection of Pressure Vessels, Heat Exchangers, Columns / Towers, Reactors and other major fabricated static equipment manufactured as per ASME or Pumps, compressor etc manufactured and tested as per API for refinery and petrochemical services. Associate Engineer Gr.I-Inspection - Electrical: BE/ B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Electrical Engineering. Experience: 2 years of relevant post qualification experience in inspection of Electrical equipment like Switch Boards, Motors, Transformers, alternators, synchronous Generators, Variable Frequency Drives, Uninterrupted Power Supplies, Electrical Control System, Battery Chargers, power cables, control cables, Electrical Bulk items like light fittings, junction boxes, cable jointing kits, cable glands etc.

rows.post_name: Associate Engineer Gr.I - Inspection Mechanical/ Metallurgical

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Associate Engineer Gr.I - Inspection Mechanical/ Metallurgical: BE/ B. Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Mechanical/ Metallurgical Engineering. Experience: 2 years of relevant post qualification experience in inspection of Pressure Vessels, Heat Exchangers, Columns / Towers, Reactors and other major fabricated static equipment manufactured as per ASME or Pumps, compressor etc manufactured and tested as per API for refinery and petrochemical services. Associate Engineer Gr.I-Inspection - Electrical: BE/ B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Electrical Engineering. Experience: 2 years of relevant post qualification experience in inspection of Electrical equipment like Switch Boards, Motors, Transformers, alternators, synchronous Generators, Variable Frequency Drives, Uninterrupted Power Supplies, Electrical Control System, Battery Chargers, power cables, control cables, Electrical Bulk items like light fittings, junction boxes, cable jointing kits, cable glands etc.

content_sections.text: Associate Engineer Grade I: Maximum Age: 32 years. Age Relaxation: SC/ST: 5 years, OBC: 3 years, PwD-General/EWS: 10 years, PwD-OBC(NCL): 13 years, PwD-SC/ST: 15 years, Persons with disabilities: 10 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the EIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of EIL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Engineers India Limited (EIL), a premier public sector undertaking in India, offering various engineering positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts advertised under this notification are Associate Engineer Grade I in Mechanical, Metallurgical, and Electrical engineering disciplines for the SCM Inspection department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies have been announced for the Associate Engineer Grade I position across various engineering disciplines and categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the starting date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process officially commences on 26 September 2026, allowing eligible candidates to submit their applications through the website.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to complete and submit the online application form is 12 October 2026. Candidates must apply before this date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE, B.Tech, or B.Sc. (Engg.) degree in Mechanical, Metallurgical, or Electrical Engineering from a recognized university or institution along with required post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for EIL Associate Engineer Grade I posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 32 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, OBC, and PwD as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Associate Engineer Grade I?
faq.answer: The monthly salary ranges from Rs. 57,600 to Rs. 64,000 depending on the city category (X, Y, or Z category cities) where the candidate is posted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises screening of applications and certificates, followed by a personal interview for shortlisted eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website of Engineers India Limited at www.engineersindia.com and filling out the application form before the deadline.
